headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 9, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate, hitting a home run and driving in one run. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 8 batters.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays), Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), and Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox). The status of these players will impact their teams' lineups and rotations.

The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins, while the Athletics traded for Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Miami Marlins made several trades, sending Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate. Soderstrom hit a home run, drove in one run, and had four at-bats in the win.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Out Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit a home run and drove in two runs, while Louis Varland earned the win and Lazaro Estrada secured the save.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, marking a tough outing for the team. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, taking the game 4-3. Key contributors for the Athletics included Henry Bolte and Eli White, who made significant impacts in the contest.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as the team continues to make moves ahead of the MLB trade deadline.
